title: Tensor-parameter composition under an adjunction with a tensor comparison
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories [def-nagata-category], each equipped with a tensor bifunctor $\otimes$ (it assigns an object $X\otimes Y$ to each pair of objects and a morphism $f\otimes g$ to each pair of morphisms, preserving identities and componentwise composition); no associator, unitor, symmetry or coherence condition is assumed. Let $F:\mathcal C	o\mathcal D$ and $G:\mathcal D	o\mathcal C$ be functors, and let $\mu_{X,Y}:FX\otimes FY\xrightarrow{\sim}F(X\otimes Y)$ be isomorphisms natural in $X,Y$, that is $F(f\otimes g)\circ\mu_{X,Y}=\mu_{X',Y'}\circ(Ff\otimes Fg)$. Let $F\dashv G$ have natural Hom bijections $\Phi_{X,Y}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(X,GY)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(FX,Y)$, unit $u$ and counit $e$, normalized by $\Phi(h)=e_Y\circ F(h)$ [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. For $S\in\mathcal C$ and $N\in\mathcal D$, define
$$\lambda_{S,N}:S\otimes GN\longrightarrow G(FS\otimes N)$$
to be the unique map whose $\Phi$-image is $(1_{FS}\otimes e_N)\circ\mu_{S,GN}^{-1}$. For objects $S,T,P\in\mathcal C$, $N,N'\in\mathcal D$ and maps $f:T\otimes P	o GN$, $g:FS\otimes N	o N'$, set
$$f^\sharp=e_N\circ F(f)\circ\mu_{T,P}:FT\otimes FP	o N.$$
Then
$$\Phi_{S\otimes(T\otimes P),N'} igl(G(g)\circ\lambda_{S,N}\circ(1_S\otimes f) igr)\circ\mu_{S,T\otimes P}\circ(1_{FS}\otimes\mu_{T,P})=g\circ(1_{FS}\otimes f^\sharp).$$
Both sides have source $FS\otimes(FT\otimes FP)$ and target $N'$. This is transport of tensor-parameter composition through the specified adjunction; it requires neither invertibility of $\lambda$, nor closedness or dualizability of the objects, nor any associativity or unit coherence. In particular it applies to a strong monoidal $F$ between monoidal categories.
